parameters.query:
-- The polling marker and the allowlist in one round trip, so the rest of the
-- workflow never has to go back to the database for a single message.
SELECT
  coalesce((SELECT value::bigint FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'telegram_offset'), 0)
    AS next_offset,
  coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'telegram_user_id', u.telegram_user_id,
              'user_id',          u.id,
              'name',             coalesce(u.display_name, u.email)))
              FROM users u WHERE u.telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb)
    AS allowlist;

-- Nothing is stored unless the sender is on the allowlist and we have both a
-- link and a title, so a stray message cannot put an item in the newsletter.
WITH me AS (
    SELECT $1::text        AS tg_id,
           nullif($2, '')  AS url,
           nullif($3, '')  AS title,
           nullif($4, '')  AS publisher,
           $5::timestamptz AS published_at,
           nullif($6, '')  AS note,
           nullif($7, '')  AS body
),
person AS (
    SELECT u.id FROM users u JOIN me ON u.telegram_user_id = me.tg_id
),
-- read before the insert below, so we can tell "saved" from "already had it"
seen AS (
    SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items i JOIN me ON i.canonical_url = me.url) AS already
),
stored AS (
    INSERT INTO items (source_id, source_url, canonical_url, title, publisher,
                       published_at, excerpt, raw_text, status, captured_by, fetched_at)
    SELECT (SELECT id FROM sources WHERE type = 'manual' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),
           me.url, me.url, me.title, me.publisher, me.published_at, me.note,
           me.body, 'new', (SELECT id FROM person), now()
      FROM me
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person)
       AND me.url IS NOT NULL
       AND me.title IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (canonical_url) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person) AS allowed,
       (SELECT id FROM stored)       AS item_id,
       (SELECT already FROM seen)    AS already_known;

-- One statement, so an item is never marked summarised without a summary.
WITH s AS (
    INSERT INTO summaries (item_id, language, text, provider, model)
    VALUES ($1::bigint, 'fi', $2, $3, $4)
    ON CONFLICT (item_id, language) DO UPDATE
       SET text = EXCLUDED.text, generated_at = now()
    RETURNING item_id
)
UPDATE items SET status = 'summarised' WHERE id = (SELECT item_id FROM s);
